A clean, crisp digital gouache illustration for a video game background, looking down at about forty degrees on a burned conifer forest a few years after a wildfire in the Cascades. Tall, straight, tapering dead trunks stand apart from each other, some charred black with cracked bark, some weathered to silver grey. The sun is in the upper left, so each trunk is lit along its left side and dark on its right. Their tops are a mix of fine spikes and snapped jagged ends, with only a few short stub limbs angled upward; no needles. Bright magenta fireweed and young green shoots cover the ground between them. No fire, no smoke, no buildings, no people.
